intent: Settings for one connected integration: status with a banner when syncing, failing or needing reauth, the sync settings (kit controls you pass in), granted scopes, Save changes, and Disconnect behind a danger AlertDialog. Frames kit Select, Switch and Input; uses Badge, Button, AlertDialog and Empty.
useWhen: configure a connected integration in settings
show sync status, errors and expired access
disconnect an integration with a confirmation
doNotUseWhen: choosing which integration to connect — IntegrationPicker
a general settings form — the settings-form pattern

settings.note: { id, label, description?, control, controlId? }[]; control is a kit Select, Switch or Input with id={controlId}.

onSave.note: Save changes, the one solid primary; ⌘/Ctrl+S.

onReconnect.note: Needs reauth: the solid primary; Save steps down to outline and the settings lock.

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h3 provider name
status is a word in a kit Badge; error and needs-reauth banners are role=alert, syncing is role=status
settings are a fieldset with a Settings legend; each label names its control by controlId
the fieldset is disabled while saving or until reconnect
Disconnect opens a danger AlertDialog; Keep connected returns focus to Disconnect

doNot: Do not invent a local ConnectionSettings or IntegrationForm
Do not disconnect without the AlertDialog
Do not show two solid primaries; Reconnect takes over from Save
snippet: <IntegrationSettings name="Northwind Ledger" status="connected" lastSync="Last sync 4 min ago · example provider" settings={settings} scopes={["invoices:read", "payments:read"]} onSave={save} onCancel={reset} onSyncNow={sync} onDisconnect={disconnect} />
